heading_path: 17. Annex A1 - Deferment of acceptance date - Grounds and time limits

cells.text: Reason for Deferment
Termination of Deferment
Time Remaining
Citation under subsection 44 (1) or 44(2) of a pending application
When cited application is registered, withdrawn, rejected or lapsed, or where Registrar is satisfied that a citation no longer exists
Balance of time remaining prior to deferment
Gathering evidence to overcome section 44 citation by proving “honest concurrent use”, “other circumstances” or “prior use”
6 months from the date of deferment
Balance of time remaining prior to deferment
Non-use action under section 92
When proceedings in respect of the other trade mark have been finalised
Balance of time remaining prior to deferment
Copy of rules of certification trade mark sent to ACCC
When the Registrar publishes the acceptance or rejection of application
Balance of time remaining prior to deferment
Cited registered trade mark un-renewed and within 6 months of expiry
When the registration is either renewed or removed
Balance of time remaining prior to deferment
Where an applicant has died
At Registrar's discretion, based on individual circumstances (usually up to 12 months)
Balance of time remaining prior to deferment
Applicant has requested ex parte hearing
When the applicant withdraws the request, or the Registrar decides to accept or reject the application
Balance of time remaining prior to deferment
TM application under appeal or pending review of Registrar's decision in a court or in the ART, or where a rectification action or appeal or appeal period in relation to such an action is pending
3 months after decision or such time as the prescribed court or ART may allow or, where decision is appealable, 2 months after the issue of that decision
Balance of time remaining prior to deferment
